name: Atlas Bird
storyline:
Atlas Bird follows a cheerful little bird on a colorful journey across nine destinations. As the adventure unfolds, players travel through different locations, overcome increasingly challenging obstacles, and discover illustrated story scenes that connect the stages.

Each destination brings the bird one step further along its journey, combining arcade flying challenges with a lighthearted travel adventure.
summary:
Atlas Bird is a 2D arcade flying game for Android featuring nine destinations and illustrated story scenes. Players control a bird using tap-based inputs to navigate through obstacles and progress across increasingly challenging stages.

As the game progresses, gravity increases and jumps become shorter, requiring more precise timing to pass through narrower gaps.

The game features colorful environments, stage-based progression, and saved player progress. Atlas Bird is free to play and includes optional rewarded advertisements without forced ads.
